messages:
miles: Quick heads-up — planning a canary rollout of inference-service v2.8.1 at 15:00 UTC today. Canary will target 5% traffic for 10 minutes, then 25% if healthy. Main goals: verify latency tail fixes and observe KV-cache impact. :rocket:

tara: Ack, I can own the dashboards and watch the canary live. Which panels should I put at the top? :eyes:

miles: Top priority: p50/p95/p99 latency (text-gen), token/s throughput, GPU util, memory + KV-cache hit rate, model error rate (5xx / inference errors). Also add request count and per-model QPS.

tara: Got it. I'll spin up a temporary dashboard (canary/v2.8.1) and post the link before 14:50 UTC. Will include an annotations layer for the rollout windows.

sasha: Who's on rollback if things look bad? We should have a one-liner revert and an owner.

miles: Rollback plan: revert traffic routing in gateway -> set canary to 0% and drain. One-liner in infra repo to revert route: ``curl -XPOST $GATEWAY/deploys/rollback -d '{"service":"inference","version":"v2.8.1-canary"}'``. Jordan will be primary rollback owner, Tara will help with metrics verification.

jordan: I'll be on standby at 14:45–15:30 UTC. If p99 > 800ms or error rate > 0.8% sustained for 2 minutes we revert. I'll post a short checklist in the runbook section.

tara: Note: to reduce noise, I'll mute the alert: "inference-error-rate" during the initial 10m canary window and re-enable after. We'll create a temporary alert rule change and document it. :white_check_mark:

miles: +1 to muting alerts. Also increase trace sampling to 50% for canary to get better spans: ``kubectl -n infra patch configmap tracing --patch '{"data":{"sample_rate":"0.5"}}'``. Remember to revert sampling to 5% afterwards.

ci-bot: CI checks for v2.8.1 passed — unit/integration/e2e green. build: 1769a2f. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Scheduled canary rollout for inference-service v2.8.1 at 2026-03-17T15:00:00Z. Notifying oncall.

sasha: A few quick smoke checks I suggest after canary goes live:
- ``/health`` should be 200 across canary pods
- run a small prompt load: ``for i in 1..50; do curl -s -X POST $API/gen -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'; done`` and check for errors
- check KV-cache hit rate and tail memory usage

tara: Dashboard draft: https://console.redwood/dashboards/temporary/canary-v281 (I've added p99, traces, GPU util, cache hit). I'll keep the link pinned to channel.

miles: Nice — can you also add a short panel that shows the version split (canary vs prod) and the canary pod IDs? Helps correlate traces.

tara: Added version-split and pod list. Also set an annotation for manually triggered rollback events.

jordan: If we need immediate rollback, I'll run the revert curl and then verify traffic goes back to 100% prod. After revert, we'll run a small smoke script and mark the incident if error rate > 1%.

miles: One more: add a quick query to traces that filters by "kv_cache_miss" tag so we can see if cache misses spike. Example trace search: ``service:inference AND tags.kv_cache_miss:true``

tara: Done. Trace query panel added. I'll open the dashboard 10m before rollout and keep it shared.

sasha: Cool. I'll be available for early signs of regressions and will escalate to oncall if needed. Otherwise, question — do we want to do a small warmup traffic to populate KV caches before canary starts?

miles: Yes, plan is a 2-minute warmup hitting a few common prompts at 0.5 qps/pod. I'll trigger the warmup script at 14:58 UTC.

jordan: Sounds good. I'll watch p99 and error-rate. If any of the thresholds hit I'll call rollback and ping #incidents.

miles: Thanks all. I'll post a final 'rolling now' notice 2 mins before and a success or revert summary after. :handshake:
